synth.notes:
Single horizontal mirror axis (wall band) + 3x3-block pieces; piece blocks off the axis row reflect to block row 2A-r (clipped, skipped on piece blocks).
A1-4 move the selection: axis rows only within bounds; pieces within bounds and never onto another piece; the axis passes under pieces.
Step-64 mechanic: the A5 cycle is axis -> pieces by size desc (tie: min block) -> axis. It follows piece identity, not current bbox rank, so L(7) -> T(6) -> axis. Ordering by bbox fails only step 64.
The 'reflection gone' hypothesis is a red herring: reflections are re-rendered and merge or re-rank as 4-connected components. Wall/player names rank components of own cells plus all 0 dots by bbox.
Stateless, no hidden state. Unconfirmed: the cycle order when pieces are the same size, and how merged unselected pieces split when the axis is selected.
